system.description:
Story-based subclass. "Pointy-hat-man do magic. ME have pointy hat. ME DO MAGIC!" —Fleximus the Wise

Muscle Magic. Your muscles have "unlocked the secrets of the arcane" (and any fool who disputes that is about to have a bad day). You lose access to the Savage Arsenal and all weapon proficiencies but gain access to "Muscle Spells" which require you to have a certain number of Fury Dice to cast.

LEVEL 3

STRENGTH of Mind. Add your STR to INT-based skill checks.

LEVEL 7

I'm Fine! Totally Fine! (1/Safe Rest) When you drop to 0 hp, give a number of actions out to your allies equal to the number of Fury Dice you had.

LEVEL 11

Flexpertise. Reduce the Fury Die Requirement of your Muscle Spells by 2.

LEVEL 15

High Flexemplar. Gain +4 max wounds. "I'm Fine! Totally Fine!" is unlimited.

"Muscle Spells"

Power Word: Clobber (1 Action). Requires: 1 FD. 1d10+STR+Fury Dice (FD) damage. On Hit: a Medium or smaller creature is Clobbered.

Clobbered: Any Medium or smaller creature that is Dazed, Grappled, Prone, or has been forcefully moved this round is also considered Clobbered this round.

Throwmaturgy (2 Actions). Requires: 1 FD. Reach: 3/FD. Throw a Clobbered creature at another enemy; both suffer 1d6+STR+FD damage and land Prone (if Medium or smaller). OR: for 1 action throw a rock or similarly throwable object instead.

3/FD? If you have 1 Fury Die, you can throw 3 spaces; 2 Fury Dice, 6 spaces; and so on.

Polymorph: CHICKEN! (1 Action). Requires: 3 FD. Reach: 3/FD. Yell "Chicken!" at a creature, Frightening them until the end of their next turn (Large+ creatures: Taunted instead).

Thunderfist (2 Actions). Requires: 3 FD. Reach: Cone FD, AoE. 1d20+STR+FD.

"Teleport" (1 Action). Requires: 4 FD. Sum your Fury Dice, leap up to that many spaces.

Meat Ward (1 Action). Requires: 5 FD. Reach: 1. Reaction: When attacked, move another Medium or smaller creature into your space and you move to another adjacent space. (Each reaction is limited to 1/round.)

Powershout: WEAKLINGS! (2 Actions). Requires: 6 FD. Reach: 6, AoE. (1/encounter) FD damage to enemies, Frightening them (Large+ enemies are Taunted instead) and attacks deal +10 damage to Armored enemies this round.

Earthquake (2 Actions). Requires: 7 FD. (1/encounter) Leap into the air and land with seismic force up to 2× your Speed away. Creatures within Reach 3 take 3d20+FD damage and become Slowed. Clobbered creatures are knocked Prone.
